# BIG LWA hosted-editor source copies

These folders are pinned source-code snapshots of the four open-source
Rust editors used by BIG LWA. They are held in the editor-sources
branch to keep the GitHub Pages live site small and unchanged.

Copyright stays with the original ArtCraft Team and contributors.
The upstream code is dual MIT or Apache-2.0. Bundled assets have
separate attribution and license terms; see each editor's NOTICE,
ATTRIBUTION.md, ASSETS.md, licenses/ and related files.

The trademarked docs/brand/ assets and original app icon artwork
have been omitted. These copies have NOT been separately compiled
into BIG LWA-branded binaries; the production site still uses the
existing verified upstream WebAssembly releases.
